name: [🔥] Get +1 Skill Point Every Second
desc:
⚡ Welcome to Get +1 Skill Point Every Second! ⚡

Earn Skill Points every second while defeating enemies and becoming stronger! 💪

⚔️ Features
• ⏱ Gain Skill Points every second
• 👹 Fight enemies to progress faster
• 📈 Upgrade stats and weapons
• 🌟 Unlock 200+ powerful passives with unique buffs
• 🏆 Earn special badges for exclusive rewards
• 🚀 Discover new ways to become extremely powerful

👍 Like and favorite the game if you enjoy it, it helps the game grow!

🛠 Updates
We try to update the game daily with new content and improvements.

🎮 Controls
• 💨 Press Q to Dash (PC only)
• 🚫 Press R to Reset Velocity (PC only)

⚠ Data Issue?
If your data does not load, try rejoining the game first.
If it still does not appear, you can message MathMagic10 or Tekk below.

💡 Inspired by: Every Second Add 1 Skill Point by GiTcHeD Games
